Single-sample Gene Set Scoring for Single-Cell Data

Source: R/64-BenchGeneScore.R
BenchGeneScore.Rd

Scores one or more gene sets in every cell of a screened single-cell dataset with ssGSEA, AUCell, UCell or AddModuleScore. All backends return the same gene-set-by-cell matrix layout, so the cell-level signal recovered by different screening methods can be compared on a common ground.

Usage

BenchGeneScore(obj, ...)

# S3 method for class '`SigBridgeR::BenchGeneScoreConfig`'
BenchGeneScore(obj, ..., verbose = getFuncOption("verbose"))

# S3 method for class '`SigBridgeR::ScreenMethodResult`'
BenchGeneScore(obj, ...)

# S3 method for class 'Seurat'
BenchGeneScore(
  obj,
  method = c("ssGSEA", "AUCell", "UCell", "AddModuleScore"),
  ...
)

Arguments

obj

The object to score, one of:

  • a Seurat object, scored as is;

  • a ScreenMethodResult object, whose scRNA_data slot is scored;

  • a BenchGeneScoreConfig object, whose screen_method entries are all run through Screen() first and the accumulated labels are scored in a single pass.

...

Additional named arguments forwarded to the selected backend. Arguments are matched against the formal argument names of the backend and split automatically over the two stages when a method needs two calls:

  • "ssGSEA": GSVA::ssgseaParam() and GSVA::gsva();

  • "AUCell": AUCell::AUCell_buildRankings() and AUCell::AUCell_calcAUC();

  • "UCell": UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell();

  • "AddModuleScore": Seurat::AddModuleScore().

verbose

Logical. Whether to report progress information. Default: TRUE.

method

Character. Scoring backend, one of "ssGSEA", "AUCell", "UCell" or "AddModuleScore". Default: "ssGSEA".

Value

A numeric matrix with gene sets in rows and cells in columns. Gene sets dropped by backend-specific filtering are omitted from the result.

Details

Dispatch

BenchGeneScore() dispatches on the class of obj, so a BenchGeneScoreConfig is benchmarked and a ScreenMethodResult is unwrapped before the actual scoring happens. BenchGeneScore.Seurat() is itself a generic dispatching on method: every backend lives in its own BenchGeneScoreSeurat.<method> function and its package is loaded on demand by rlang::check_installed(), so neither GSVA, AUCell, UCell nor Seurat is required to merely call the generic.

Config input

For a BenchGeneScoreConfig input, the configured screen_method entries are run one after another with Screen(). Every run adds its labels to the meta.data of the working Seurat object and the labels are accumulated across methods, after which the scores are computed once. Scores are therefore comparable across screening methods by construction.

Backend notes

  • "UCell" is called with name = "" so that gene-set names stay untouched, and its cell-by-gene-set output is transposed to the common layout.

  • "AddModuleScore" drops the genes absent from assay, drops the gene sets that become empty, and stores the scores under an internal .BenchGeneScore prefix so that the meta.data of obj is left untouched. It aborts when no gene set survives the filtering.

  • "AUCell" builds the rankings with plotStats = FALSE, since the plot is only meaningful for a manual inspection.

See also

BenchGeneScoreConfig(), BenchGeneScoreConfigSet(), Screen(), BenchGSEA(), BenchAcc()

Other Benchmark: BenchAcc(), BenchGSEA(), BenchMemory()

Examples

# \donttest{
counts <- matrix(
  rep(seq_len(20), times = 5) + rep(seq_len(5), each = 20),
  nrow = 20,
  dimnames = list(paste0("Gene", seq_len(20)), paste0("Cell", seq_len(5)))
)
obj <- Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts)
#> Warning: Data is of class matrix. Coercing to dgCMatrix.
obj <- Seurat::NormalizeData(obj, verbose = FALSE)
pathways <- list(
  First = paste0("Gene", 1:5),
  Second = paste0("Gene", 6:10)
)
scores <- try(BenchGeneScore(obj, pathways, method = "ssGSEA", verbose = FALSE)) # require GSVA
#> ℹ 100 nonzeros (less than 2^31) and 0.00% sparsity
#> ! Input expression data is sparse, but the ssGSEA algorithm does not deal with sparsity in any specific way, and data will be converted into a dense matrix format
# }
